### 🐛 Describe the bug

Sending an request that asks for prompt logprobs while also specifying certain sampling parameters can result in an Internal Server Error.  For example:
```
curl -v http://localhost:8000/v1/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
      "model": "meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B",
      "prompt": "correct horse battery staple",
      "echo": 1,
      "logprobs": 1,
      "temperature": 1,
      "top_k": 1
  }'
```

From what I can see this happens because the logprobs on at least one of the prompt tokens is -inf. The `top_k: 1` sampling parameter that makes the probablity of any token other than the top-1 0.
